lines.text: Oh dear, you're holding your head very stiffly. What happened?
Woke up like this on Saturday, I can't turn to the right at all.
Any tingling or weakness in your arms?
A little tingling in my right thumb, or is that just from texting, I don't know.
Let me have a look. Your reflexes and strength in both arms are normal, which is reassuring.
I'm going to take you through some gentle neck movements and do a little massage.
Tilt your ear towards your shoulder, hold it for twenty seconds, every couple of hours, and use a warm wheat bag in between.
If the tingling spreads or your hand gets weak, come straight back.
Okay, all the best, bye bye.
Hello, hello, come in, sorry for the wait, we're running behind today.
No problem. It's my lower back again, I've had it on and off for years but it's much worse this week.
